initial.name: workflow-authoring
initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, realistic, implementable desktop application UI screenshot for OpenCode Loopper, a Chinese AI workflow authoring and execution application. Landscape 16:10, high resolution. Flat front-facing screenshot with no device frame, no perspective, no marketing decoration. Precise Chinese typography (simplified Chinese), clean professional engineering application, spacious but information-dense. Existing app aesthetic: deep navy left navigation and header, slate-blue surfaces, blue primary controls, mint success, amber pending/manual attention. Thin borders, modest rounded corners, compact line icons. Avoid neon glow, glassmorphism, huge charts or decorative illustrations. Consistent navigation: Loopper logo; 项目, 需求任务, 流程, 任务记录, 知识库; bottom 角色管理, 设置. Show accessible text labels with state badges, do not rely on color alone.
Primary request: Detailed workflow authoring canvas screen. Header breadcrumb 流程 / 自定义开发流程 with 草稿 badge; upper right 次要 button 预览, primary 保存流程. Below: contextual toolbar 撤销 重做 自动布局. On left inside main content a narrow searchable module palette titled 工作模块 with tabs 预设模块 自由任务; drag items 需求澄清, 方案设计, 知识检索, 开发任务, 代码审查, 人工确认, 条件分支. Large central dotted grid canvas (about 55% full image width) has a readable top-down connected workflow: 需求澄清 (设计师) → 方案设计 (设计师) → two parallel branches 接口开发 (执行者), 测试编写 (执行者) → 代码审查 (审查者) → 人工确认. On cards show separate role pill and task title, small input/output line such as 交付物：设计方案 and a small pause icon on 人工确认. Orthogonal connectors with arrows, generous whitespace, no crossing edges. The selected 方案设计 node has blue border, not glowing. Right inspector panel about 310 pixels wide titled 方案设计, tabs 任务 输入输出 完成规则; content shows 角色 dropdown 设计师, 任务说明 multiline text 依据已确认需求设计订单导出方案, 输入 pill 已确认需求, 预期交付物 设计方案, 完成标准 提交有效交付物, action 保存节点. Bottom-left canvas zoom 85%, fit, minimap bottom-right. Include understated footer 模板修改不影响已创建的任务. No execution progress, no fake terminal in authoring mode. Text legibility and visual hierarchy are paramount.

initial.name: workflow-library
initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, realistic, implementable desktop application UI screenshot for OpenCode Loopper, a Chinese AI workflow authoring and execution application. Landscape 16:10, high resolution. Flat front-facing screenshot with no device frame, no perspective, no marketing decoration. Precise Chinese typography (simplified Chinese), clean professional engineering application, spacious but information-dense. Existing app aesthetic: deep navy left navigation and header, slate-blue surfaces, blue primary controls, mint success, amber pending/manual attention. Thin borders, modest rounded corners, compact line icons. Avoid neon glow, glassmorphism, huge charts or decorative illustrations. Consistent navigation: Loopper logo; 项目, 需求任务, 流程, 任务记录, 知识库; bottom 角色管理, 设置. Show accessible text labels with state badges, do not rely on color alone.
Primary request: Workflow library screen, active navigation 流程. Main header title 流程, subtitle 将常用工作保存为可复用的流程. Upper right blue primary 新建流程. Filter row with search 搜索流程 and tabs 全部, 内置流程, 我的流程. Main content uses a refined 3-column grid of six medium-sized workflow cards, not oversized KPI dashboard cards. Each card includes small monochrome category icon, workflow name, ownership badge 内置 or 自定义, one sentence description, tiny meaningful line preview of 3-5 connected nodes, chips listing roles, bottom node count and actions. Six cards: 默认开发流程 (内置, 需求澄清 → 方案设计 → 开发 → 验收), 代码审查 (内置), 单元测试开发 (内置), 详细设计编写 (内置), 轻量开发流程 (自定义), 资料调研与文档 (自定义). On built-in cards visible 查看流程 and 复制; on custom cards 编辑 and overflow menu. One custom card lightly selected; right-side detail area or narrow lower context panel shows its description, 5 个节点, 3 类角色, small preview and 使用此流程 button. No metrics, billing, avatar faces or decorative artwork. Chinese labels short and correct, enough room around card previews. User can tell creation, cloning and using a flow apart.

initial.name: workflow-execution
initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, realistic, implementable desktop application UI screenshot for OpenCode Loopper, a Chinese AI workflow authoring and execution application. Landscape 16:10, high resolution. Flat front-facing screenshot with no device frame, no perspective, no marketing decoration. Precise Chinese typography (simplified Chinese), clean professional engineering application, spacious but information-dense. Existing app aesthetic: deep navy left navigation and header, slate-blue surfaces, blue primary controls, mint success, amber pending/manual attention. Thin borders, modest rounded corners, compact line icons. Avoid neon glow, glassmorphism, huge charts or decorative illustrations. Consistent navigation: Loopper logo; 项目, 需求任务, 流程, 任务记录, 知识库; bottom 角色管理, 设置. Show accessible text labels with state badges, do not rely on color alone.
Primary request: A requirement task execution canvas in a user review state for an AI-proposed change. Header breadcrumb 需求任务 / 订单导出功能, amber status 等待确认. Buttons 查看交付物, 暂停后续执行, greyed 继续执行. A slim amber banner above canvas says 流程规划师已提出后续计划，确认后继续执行 with 查看变更. Left main canvas large (70% main content) on subtle dotted grid: 已确认需求 (设计师, 已完成, 交付物 1), 方案设计 (设计师, 已完成, 交付物 2), 流程规划 (流程规划师, 待确认). Below planner a dashed framed region titled 待确认的后续计划 with proposed stages 实现导出接口 (执行者, 新增), 编写测试 (执行者, 新增), 代码审查 (审查者, 保留), and 人工检查 with pause icon. Arrows clear, proposed nodes marked with dashed outlines + 新增 badges; completed nodes solid and checkmarked. Existing completed nodes outside candidate region stay unchanged. The right inspector titled 计划变更, subtitle 当前计划 v1 → 候选计划 v2, lists 新增 2, 调整 1, 保留 2; tabs 变更内容 交付物. Below show selected candidate node 实现导出接口 with input chips 设计方案 v1 and 已确认需求 v1, output 代码成果、测试结果; contextual note 已完成节点及交付物保持原版本. Footer of inspector pinned with secondary 返回修改 and primary 确认并继续. Bottom canvas compact event strip 方案设计已完成 · 设计方案 v1 已保存. Must clearly communicate proposal is not yet active, human confirmation required, artifact lineage and immutable completed work. No automatic apply toggle, no inaccessible hidden statuses. This should feel like an actual well-designed workflow editor with a useful readable inspector, not a conceptual infographic.

refinements.name: workflow-execution-v2
refinements.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, ui-mockup. Edit the existing Loopper workflow execution screenshot, preserve its entire layout, navy shell, bright dotted canvas, typography scale, node positions, connectors, inspector and all functionality. Only fix these exact text/semantics issues: header metadata must say 当前计划：v1 · 候选计划：v2（待确认）, NOT current version v2, because proposed changes have not taken effect. Remove fictional creation date, personal avatar name and owner from header, replace metadata with 项目：示例项目. In the proposed 实现导出接口 card the role must be 开发工程师, not 设计者. The 编写测试 card and matching inspector role must also say 开发工程师. The 代码审查 card role must say 评审员. Keep 流程规划师 as its role. Change the right summary counts to 新增 2 / 调整 0 / 保留 2. Replace 返回修改 bottom button with 编辑候选计划, keep primary 确认并继续. Remove dismiss X from the amber blocking banner so an unresolved required confirmation is not dismissible. No other changes. Maintain crisp Chinese text.

refinements.name: workflow-library-v2
refinements.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit, ui-mockup. Edit this Loopper workflow library screenshot, preserve the full beautiful navy layout, six card grid, selected custom card and right detail panel. Fix only semantic text consistency. Selected 轻量开发流程 must have FOUR nodes both in card and right panel. Right mini flow has four steps: 需求确认, 快速设计, 开发实现, 测试验证. Remove 发布交付 step entirely; no workflow should imply external deployment by default. Right panel count 4 个节点, 3 类角色. Use real product role names 需求分析师, 设计师, 开发工程师, 评审员 across the cards, replacing invented product-manager and research personnel roles with matching configured roles such as 知识库助手. The default development flow role chips should be 设计师, 开发工程师, 验收工程师. Delete fictional dates at right bottom, replace with short line 修改流程不会影响已创建的任务. Preserve text size and spacing; no new features, no new visual decoration.
